messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Duplicate claims are created because the system fails to warn staff of existing matching incidents, forcing manual linking and causing delays.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "date": "2026-10-25T16:14:00+00:00",
   "quote": "We’re seeing cases where the same claim twice appears because the system doesn’t alert staff when a matching incident already exists in intake — we’ve had to manually link them after the fact, which delays payments and reporting.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-04T09:00:00Z",
   "quote": "click \"Link to existing claim\", dead x1",
   "route": "sessions"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-28T08:08:00+00:00",
   "quote": "We’re getting the same claim twice when a policyholder reports via phone and then the portal — no alert pops up at intake, and it’s causing duplicate records.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-31T11:19:00+00:00",
   "quote": "We’re seeing a duplicate loss report scenario where the same incident comes in via phone and portal, creating two claims without any intake warning — we’ve even spotted disabled UI buttons that should allow linking but don’t work.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-28T14:41:00+00:00",
   "quote": "When a policyholder reports the same incident both by phone and through the web portal, the system doesn’t alert us — it just creates two separate claims, which is a classic duplicate loss report scenario and causes confusion in reserves and reporting.",
   "route": "onboarding"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-18T15:03:00+00:00",
   "quote": "we’ve had several instances where the same loss gets reported twice — once by phone, once via web — and the system doesn’t warn us...the system doesn’t show any warning at intake, which leads to duplicate records and inaccurate reserves.",
   "route": "onboarding"
  }
 ],
 "title": "Duplicate claims are created because the system fails to warn staff of"
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The claim is that duplicate claims are created because Keelwater's product fails to warn staff of matching incidents at intake, forcing manual linking. Multiple quotes (support, onboarding, sessions routes, Sep–Oct 2026) consistently describe the same product behavior: no duplicate warning when the same incident arrives via phone and portal, plus a broken 'Link to existing claim' button and disabled UI linking controls. This is a product defect a squad could act on (intake duplicate detection and linking functionality), not a pricing, contract, or customer-side issue, and no help article would resolve it. All items support the signal.","verdict": "pass"}
